sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.5
sources.evidence: Announcement dated November 24, 2025 says Opus 4.5 is available that day and identifies claude-opus-4-5-20251101; describes coding, reasoning and agentic use.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact dated ID and alias; November 24, 2025 release; 200K context, 64K output, extended thinking and text/image input to text output. Current comparison table labels this model legacy and contains no parameter counts.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full 153-page PDF retrieved with curl after web extraction hit its size limit. Page 8 names Anthropic as developer; page 9 describes optional extended thinking and function calls; section 2.12 reports actual multi-step MCP tool use. No production parameter count found.

sources.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
sources.evidence: July 6, 2026 Anthropic research explains Transformer residual streams and layers in Methods and explicitly includes Opus 4.5 among studied models, with exact-model intervention experiments. It does not disclose dense versus MoE topology or parameter counts; layer positions are normalized percentages.

sources.title: PDF support - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing, using vision for text, charts and images. Combined with the exact model page marking Opus 4.5 active (legacy), supports the catalog PDF input capability.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 article explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Used only as Claude distribution-policy evidence, not as exact-model technical evidence.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Anthropic API access is governed by commercial service terms with use restrictions and retained intellectual property rights, supporting the descriptive proprietary classification rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.6 System Card
sources.evidence: Full 213-page PDF retrieved and text searched; page 18 Table 2.3.A explicitly compares Opus 4.5 benchmark scores but does not give total or active parameter counts. No exact-model size disclosure found in the card.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full September 22, 2026 PDF retrieved and searched for parameter counts, model size and Opus 4.5. No Opus 4.5 size disclosure found; no sibling specification transferred.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full October 7, 2026 PDF retrieved and searched for parameter counts, model size and Opus 4.5. No Opus 4.5 size disclosure found; no sibling specification transferred.

sources.title: Models overview - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Explains the Models API line field and specifically states that Opus 4.5 belongs to the opus line, supporting the normalized claude-opus family.

name.note: Exact product name and dated API ID match the frozen record.

developer.note: Original system card page 8 explicitly identifies the developer.

family.note: Catalog-normalized family label matches the documented opus model line.

release_date.note: Launch announcement and exact model documentation explicitly give this public release date; the ID suffix 20251101 is not the release date.

open_weights.note: Exact model has hosted platform availability; first-party Claude distribution policy expressly says model weights are not publicly released.

license.note: Descriptive classification for a Claude service under proprietary commercial terms; no open-weight license is claimed.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter count disclosed in the inspected original card, later model comparison sources or exact-model interpretability paper. No estimate inferred from capability or feature counts.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active count disclosed in inspected sources. Dense versus MoE is not established, and total cannot be equated with active count.

architecture.note: Methods describe Transformer residual-stream computation and explicitly include Opus 4.5 experiments. Supports the broad architecture only; does not establish dense/MoE structure or a physical layer count.

context_window.note: Exact public API model specification is 200K tokens. Larger internal evaluation configurations in the card do not establish a larger public context limit.

modalities.note: Exact model page specifies text and image input with text output. PDF is a supported API document input format through text/vision processing, not an independent neural modality.

reasoning.note: Extended thinking is optional, explicitly described for this exact model in section 1.1.2.

tool_call.note: Function calls are expressly included in the effort interface; section 2.12 evaluates Opus 4.5 on multi-step MCP tool invocation.

description.value: Claude Opus model for reasoning, coding and agentic tool use, with optional extended thinking.
description.note: Replaces time-sensitive flagship wording with documented capabilities; the current model page marks Opus 4.5 legacy.

patch.description: Claude Opus model for reasoning, coding and agentic tool use, with optional extended thinking.

sources.label: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities

patch.notes: Transformer architecture is supported by Anthropic interpretability research that explicitly studies Opus 4.5. Dense/MoE topology and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the inspected primary sources. PDF denotes an API document input format processed through text and vision.

summary: Confirms the exact API snapshot, November 24, 2025 release, 200K context, input/output support, optional reasoning and tool calling. Adds supported transformer architecture and proprietary classification; removes stale flagship wording. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed after original and later first-party sources were inspected.
